description: This file defines the `LoanStatusChangedBusinessEvent` class, a domain event related to changes in loan status within the Fineract project. It extends `LoanBusinessEvent` and encapsulates information about the previous status of a loan when its status changes.

classes.name: LoanStatusChangedBusinessEvent
classes.description: A domain event representing a change in the status of a loan, capturing the old status before the change.

methods.name: LoanStatusChangedBusinessEvent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event with the loan and its previous status.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the string identifier for this event type.

methods.name: getOldStatus
methods.description: Returns the previous status of the loan before the change.
